title: Opposition Stages Walkout From All-Party Meeting Over Centre's Invite to Rebel TMC MPs
description: A political dispute arose before the Monsoon Session as several INDIA bloc parties walked out of an all-party meeting. They protested the Centre's separate invitation to the rebel TMC faction, alleging attempts to legitimize the split. Opposition leaders condemned this as interference in internal matters, while the meeting continued with BJP participation, emphasizing parliamentary functionality.
